title: FII NOCONTRACT marking used to hide UFO programs in DOE/NNSA national labs
place_text: Sandia, Lawrence Livermore, Los Alamos, Y-12/Oak Ridge

tellings.quote: I believe this is a security mechanism used for Department of Energy and their semi-autonomous subordinate agency, the National Nuclear Security Administration to offiscate UFO programs within DOE and NSA National Labs

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels in January 2026, describes a document label called "FII NOCONTRACT". He says he believes it is a security marking that the Department of Energy and its nuclear weapons arm, the National Nuclear Security Administration, use to hide UFO programs inside the national laboratories they run, such as Sandia, Lawrence Livermore, Los Alamos and Oak Ridge. He gives credit for the documents to a proposed US law on disclosing UFO records, and if he is right, it would mean UFO work is tucked away inside America's nuclear labs.
